features.head: Multi-lane
features.body: Up to 6 lanes for high-volume simultaneous output.

features.head: Biodegradable ready
features.body: Compatible with PBAT+PLA blends out of the box.

features.head: Servo precision
features.body: ±0.5 mm sealing repeat accuracy across all lanes.

features.head: Fast changeover
features.body: Tool-free width adjustment in under 15 minutes.

features.head: Bottom seal
features.body: Continuous bottom-seal for flat bags with precision tension control.

features.head: Compact footprint
features.body: Space-saving design for medium-volume production lines.

features.head: Easy operation
features.body: Touchscreen HMI with recipe memory for quick batch switching.

features.head: Low maintenance
features.body: Fewer moving parts with sealed bearing assemblies throughout.

features.head: Roll format
features.body: Produces perforated roll bags for automatic dispensing systems.

features.head: Perforation unit
features.body: Integrated blade perforation with adjustable pitch and depth.

features.head: Winding system
features.body: Automatic roll winding with tension control for uniform rolls.

features.head: Quick sizing
features.body: Motorized width adjustment with digital position readout.

features.head: T-shirt bags
features.body: Designed for vest/T-shirt bags with reinforced die-cut handles.

features.head: Die-cut unit
features.body: Integrated punch module for consistent handle cutouts.

features.head: Stacking conveyor
features.body: Automated counting and stacking for pack-ready output.

features.head: High throughput
features.body: Up to 250 bags per minute with multi-lane parallel processing.

features.head: Multi-layer
features.body: 5-layer co-extrusion for advanced barrier and seal properties.

features.head: High output
features.body: 350 kg/h throughput with internal bubble cooling system.

features.head: Web width
features.body: 2200 mm lay-flat for large-format film applications.

features.head: Precision gauging
features.body: Online thickness measurement with closed-loop auto adjustment.

features.head: 3-layer co-ex
features.body: High-performance 3-layer blown film for general packaging.

features.head: Energy efficient
features.body: Low-energy IBC design with optimized air ring technology.

features.head: Consistent gauge
features.body: Auto-profiled die gap for uniform film thickness across the web.

features.head: User-friendly
features.body: Recipe-based controls with touch panel and data logging.

features.head: Ultra-wide
features.body: 2500 mm lay-flat width for industrial film applications.

features.head: Simple operation
features.body: Single-layer extrusion with minimal operator training required.

features.head: Low investment
features.body: Cost-effective solution for high-volume commodity film production.

features.head: Flexible output
features.body: Runs LDPE and LLDPE with quick resin changeover.

features.head: Closed-loop
features.body: Converts post-industrial waste into high-quality reusable pellets.

features.head: Integrated cutter
features.body: Hot-face die-face cutting with underwater pelletizing system.

features.head: Filtration
features.body: Continuous melt filtration with automatic screen changer.

features.head: Energy recovery
features.body: Integrated heat recovery system reduces total power consumption.
